references.role: Sole edit target, user-preferred gargoyle: preserve monster face, carved mane, blindfold, body, crouch, star armor, claws, sword and rendering; redesign scale integration

visual_qa.identity: Original roaring fanged gargoyle face, blindfold, swept curled mane, hunched body, two bent legs, two large claw hands, star robe/armor and diagonal greatsword retained.
visual_qa.scale_readability: One wing-root now forms a single continuous heavy diagonal balance lever with a large shoulder bearing, pointer and graduated arc. Exactly two pans: oversized loaded pan in the near foreground is low, smaller empty rear pan is high. All chain attachments are traceable; old tiny wing-tip pans removed.
visual_qa.integration: Remaining bladed wing keeps the original gargoyle outline; remodeled wing-root lever sits directly on armored shoulder saddle rather than a detached prop.
visual_qa.anatomy_and_frame: One head, two arms/two legs, one diagonal sword and two pans. Entire assembly and all tips contained. Scale is asymmetric in perspective, not mirrored left/right.
visual_qa.limits: 2D concept candidate; selected base retained but none of these new three scale designs is selected.
